{"metadata":{"description":"【EMNLP 2026 Demo】A debugging framework for agentic AI systems: diagnose failures, attribute root causes, recover with evidence, and validate fixes through reruns.","id":"gh:1296792947","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"AgentDebugX","slug":"AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX","topics":["agent-debugging","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"【EMNLP 2026 Demo】A debugging framework for agentic AI systems: diagnose failures, attribute root cau"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ses, recover with evidence, and validate fixes through reruns."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# AgentDebugX"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A local-first debugging framework for agentic AI systems: diagnose failures, attribute root causes"},{"id":"p3s2","text":", recover with evidence, and validate fixes through reruns.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"AgentDebugX turns failed agent runs into structured, auditable debugging
artifacts. It ingests a liv"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e or exported trajectory, detects visible failure
signals, attributes them to responsible steps or a"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"gents, proposes recovery
actions, and prepares controlled reruns so fixes can be validated instead o"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"poses recovery
actions, and prepares controlled reruns so fixes can be validated instead of
guessed."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The project is designed for researchers and engineers building complex LLM
agents: multi-agent syste"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ms, tool-using agents, computer-use agents, benchmark
runners, and local agent development workflows"},{"id":"p5s3","text":". AgentDebugX is local-first by
default: traces stay on your machine, sharing is opt-in, and recover"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"y proposals
carry explicit policy and approval metadata into the Rerun boundary."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 📰 News"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- 🔌 **2026-08-25** — Released
`dsh-agentdebugx` v0.1.0,
the AgentDebugX plugin for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p7s2","text":"
- 📄 **2026-07-31** — Released
CUADebug, our framework for diagnosing
and repairing computer-use age"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"nt failures.
- 📄 **2026-07-21** — Released the
AgentDebugX paper, presenting our
open-source toolkit"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" for failure observability, attribution, recovery, and
rerun in LLM agents.
- 📦 **2026-05-16** — Rel"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"eased AgentDebugX on
PyPI.
- 📄 **2025-09-29** — Released
Where LLM Agents Fail and How They Can Lear"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"n From Failures,
introducing AgentErrorTaxonomy, AgentErrorBench, and AgentDebug."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## System Overview"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"AgentDebugX follows the two-stage loop used by the project paper:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`Diagnose` explains what failed and why. `Rerun` tests whether the proposed
recovery actually improv"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"es the agent behavior."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Why AgentDebugX"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Tracing tools show what happened. AgentDebugX focuses on the debugging step that
usually comes next:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Which earlier decision caused the visible failure?
- Which agent, tool call, memory read, handoff,"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" or GUI action was responsible?
- What evidence supports that diagnosis?
- What concrete recovery sh"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ould be tried?
- Did the rerun branch improve the outcome?"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The output is a portable diagnostic report that can be inspected in a local UI,
used by a CLI workfl"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ow, stored in an Error Hub bundle, or invoked from an
agentic skill."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Core Capabilities"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Portable trace schema**: framework-agnostic trajectory, event, finding, and
diagnostic report mo"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"dels.
- **Ingest adapters**: normalize raw JSON, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK,
OpenTelemetry"},{"id":"p17s3","text":", GAIA/Open Deep Research, OSWorld, and other exported traces.
- **Detect**: deterministic analyzers"},{"id":"p17s4","text":", manifest-backed rule packs, LLM judge
mode, GUI-aware signals, and taxonomy induction support.
- *"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"*Attribute**: heuristic attribution, all-at-once analysis, step-by-step
localization, binary search,"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" counterfactual attribution, MOE localization,
and DeepDebug.
- **Recover**: Reflexion, CRITIC, Self"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"-Refine, AutoManual, DeepDebug recovery,
and saga rollback style strategies.
- **Rerun**: three expl"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"icit modes for plan/export only, labeled simulation, or
observed execution in an application-owned p"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"rocess or persistent HTTP runner.
- **Local inspection UI**: no-build FastAPI dashboard for traces, "},{"id":"p17s10","text":"reports,
before/after CUA visuals, debugger discussions, saved cases, debug branches,
and rerun-from"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"-event workflows.
- **Error Hub**: scrubbed, shareable failure bundles for regression tests,
benchma"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"rk corpora, and team debugging memory.
- **Agent integrations**: generate host-runtime assets such a"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"s debugging skills
for external agent tools."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Optional extras:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Computer-use / OSWorld GUI root-cause analysis (`agentdebug.gui`) ships with the
core install and ne"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"eds no extra. The `gui` extra only adds `pillow`, which the
RCA tools use to decode screenshots. Two"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" heavier layers of the same package sit
behind their own extras: `gui-memory` for the lesson/episodi"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"c memory stack, and
`gui-app` for the provider adapters, the batch pipeline (`python -m
agentdebug.g"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ui`) and the Streamlit annotation app."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The package is installed as `agentdebugx` and imported as `agentdebug`:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Claude Code and Codex Plugins"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"AgentDebugX ships native plugins for Claude Code and Codex so an agent can
debug its own session. Th"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"e plugin bundles capture hooks and the AgentDebug
skill, which keeps two boundaries explicit:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Capture is automatic** once a project opts in. Sessions are normalized into
AgentDebugX trajecto"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ries locally and silently.
- **Diagnosis is explicit.** Ask AgentDebug in-session and the skill diag"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"noses
that exact captured trajectory with `agentdebug run --current --profile deep`.
Re-running or r"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"epairing the agent's work stays a separately authorized step."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Follow the capture quickstart to install a plugin,
enable project capture, diagnose a session, and t"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"urn capture off again."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The plugin bundles live in this repository:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Plugin | Bundle | Documentation |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The repository mirrors the paper-level workflow:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Detailed references:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- Architecture
- Trace schema
- System overview PDF"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Privacy and Safety"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"AgentDebugX is local-first:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- Trace capture and diagnosis run locally unless you explicitly configure an
external LLM endpoint.
"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"- Error Hub publishing is opt-in.
- Bundle scrubbing is available before sharing traces.
- Recovery "},{"id":"p39s3","text":"is suggest-only. External execution belongs to Rerun and requires an
explicitly configured executor."},{"id":"p39s4","text":" Recovery approval fields are auditable
metadata; deployments must enforce their own authorization p"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"olicy before
dispatch."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Diagnostic findings are hypotheses with evidence and provenance, not ground
truth. LLM Judge reports"},{"id":"p40s2","text":" retain the model's self-reported confidence;
Heuristic and DeepDebug reports omit uncalibrated conf"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"idence values. Configure
retention, access control, and redaction before collecting production trace"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"ence values. Configure
retention, access control, and redaction before collecting production traces."}],"truncated":true}
